<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="x_snc_airop_check_definition"><x_snc_airop_check_definition action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><ai_justification><![CDATA[Published VA topics define the conversational use cases Now Assist can assist with. More topics means broader AI self-service coverage.]]></ai_justification><check_name>Published VA Topic Count</check_name><check_script><![CDATA[(function(checkDef, dateFilter) {
    var ga = new GlideAggregate('sys_cs_topic');
    ga.addQuery('active', true);
    ga.addQuery('published', true);
    ga.addAggregate('COUNT');
    ga.query();
    var count = ga.next() ? parseInt(ga.getAggregate('COUNT')) : 0;

    var actualValue = count + ' published active VA topics';

    if (count >= 50) {
        return {
            status: 'ready',
            actualValue: actualValue,
            finding: count + ' published VA topics. Now Assist VA has broad topic coverage for meaningful AI-assisted self-service.'
        };
    } else if (count >= 20) {
        return {
            status: 'needs_attention',
            actualValue: actualValue,
            finding: 'Only ' + count + ' published VA topics (target: 50+). Now Assist VA self-service coverage will be limited — publish additional topics for key use cases.'
        };
    } else {
        return {
            status: 'not_ready',
            actualValue: actualValue,
            finding: 'Only ' + count + ' published VA topics. Insufficient topic coverage for meaningful Now Assist VA self-service — a minimum foundation of topics is required before AI enhancement adds value.'
        };
    }
})]]></check_script><is_active>true</is_active><is_clone_sensitive>false</is_clone_sensitive><is_manual>false</is_manual><module>VIRTUAL_AGENT</module><number>CHK0003320</number><order>30</order><remediation_guidance>Publish VA topics for top self-service categories.
